.claude-plugin/plugin.json.why: Two version lines. This repository's marketplace (ADR 0044) versions the plugin it serves, and the incubator assigns its own on promotion. Everything else in the manifest must match.

skills/register-[av]*/SKILL.md.why: Each copy names its own repository's skill map: docs/02-skill-family.md here, docs/skill-relationship-map.md in the incubator, which substitutes it on promotion (docs/05-promotion.md row 8). Nothing else may differ: ADR 0058's SKILL.md changes shipped in 0.1.19, and what the incubator's review added there was taken back here. Narrowed to the two skills ADR 0059 revision 2 did not edit, because a file may match only one difference; it folds back on re-recording.

skills/gate-*/SKILL.md.why: ADR 0059 revision 2: the gate skills' placeholders are respelled from {{NAME}} to <<NAME>>, so each YAML template parses as shipped and YML-001 can read it. What a gate renders is byte-identical. Not yet submitted; one incubator amendment carries the templates, the substitution prose in each SKILL.md and editor-binding-rules.md together, because a gate whose SKILL.md and templates disagree about the marker deploys with placeholders left in.
